t: 一支英国海军在塞辛布拉湾战役中击败了一支由西班牙战列舰组成的分舰队,并俘获了一支庞大的葡萄牙战…

dz: 一支英国海军在塞辛布拉湾战役中击败了一支由西班牙战列舰组成的分舰队,并俘获了一支庞大的葡萄牙战车.
de: An English naval force defeats a fleet of Spanish galleys, and captures a large Portuguese carrack at the Battle of Sesimbra Bay.

t: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 声称佛罗里达属于西班牙。
te: Hernando de Soto claims Florida for Spain.
dz: 埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 声称佛罗里达属于西班牙。
de: Hernando de Soto claims Florida for Spain.

t: 《诺夫哥罗德条约》在芬马克郡划定了俄罗斯和挪威之间的边界。
te: The Treaty of Novgorod delineates borders between Russia and Norway in Finnmark.
dz: 《诺夫哥罗德条约》在芬马克郡划定了俄罗斯和挪威之间的边界。
de: The Treaty of Novgorod delineates borders between Russia and Norway in Finnmark.

dz: 法国学者彼得·阿贝拉德被判定犯有异端罪.
de: The French scholar Peter Abelard is found guilty of heresy.

t: 第一次十字军东征期间，经过五个月的围困后，十字军占领了安条克。
te: After a five-month siege during the First Crusade, the Crusaders seize Antioch.
dz: 第一次十字军东征期间，经过五个月的围困后，十字军占领了安条克。
de: After a five-month siege during the First Crusade, the Crusaders seize Antioch.

te: The Byzantine emperor Philippicus is blinded, deposed and sent into exile by conspirators of the Opsikion army in Thrac…
dz: 拜占庭皇帝菲利普库斯被色雷斯奥普西金军队的阴谋者弄瞎、废黜并流放。阿纳斯塔西奥斯二世继位，开始重组拜占庭军队。
de: The Byzantine emperor Philippicus is blinded, deposed and sent into exile by conspirators of the Opsikion army in Thrace. He is succeeded by Anastasios II, who begins the reorganization of the Byzantine army.

dz: 君士坦丁王朝的罗马篡位者内波提亚努斯自封为罗马皇帝,以一群角斗士为首入罗马.
de: The Roman usurper Nepotianus, of the Constantinian dynasty, proclaims himself Roman emperor, entering Rome at the head of a group of gladiators.
